name: files
notes: Knows an entity only by its type string. Owning modules call registerFileAccess(entityType, check, { retainForever }) at startup. Config: FILE_STORE_DRIVER=local needs FILE_STORE_LOCAL_DIR and FILE_URL_SECRET (and optionally PUBLIC_API_URL); FILE_STORE_DRIVER=supabase needs SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY and SUPABASE_STORAGE_BUCKET.
